# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers of Barker's Lament, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices run free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK TO LET[/bold], colony bunks, top rack, well above the flood line. Shared locker, working heater. Day shift worker only, as the landlord sleeps in the bottom rack after nights. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], a room off the mine road for a hydroponics hand and her two children. Will trade fresh greens for part of the rent. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]KELLAND MINE[/bold] is taking on free miners for the north seam. Steel toes, steady nerves and a clean lung check. Parolee shifts are assigned by the Marshal Bureau, not by the mine office. - [bold]NIGHT OPERATOR[/bold] wanted at water treatment. Must read a river gauge, keep a log and stay awake when the dam groans. - [bold]BOTANY BEDS[/bold] need hands for the harvest rotation. Long hours, sore backs, first pick of the crop.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]WADING BOOTS[/bold], thigh high, patched once, still keeps the water out. Thirty credits, or a box of water purification tablets. - [bold]PUMP MOTOR[/bold], pulled at the scrapyard, rewound and bench tested. Ask for it at the yard office. No questions about where it came from, please.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: field glasses in a leather case, last seen on the dam walkway. Reward at the canteen, no questions. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: a miner's lamp, still lit, in the south arroyo after the last storm. Collect it at the journalist office by giving the shift number scratched on the base.
## Notices - Monsoon season is here. Do not pitch a tent in a dry arroyo. Ask anyone how this colony got its name.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
